columns.blink_left: ARFaceAnchor eyeBlinkLeft blend-shape coefficient, 0 (open)..1 (closed); not used to reject samples
columns.blink_right: ARFaceAnchor eyeBlinkRight blend-shape coefficient, 0 (open)..1 (closed); not used to reject samples
columns.left_dir_x: unit z-axis of leftEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.left_dir_y: unit z-axis of leftEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.left_dir_z: unit z-axis of leftEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.lookat_x_m: ARFaceAnchor.lookAtPoint, face-anchor coordinates, metres (+x = subject's left)
columns.lookat_z_m: ARFaceAnchor.lookAtPoint, face-anchor coordinates, metres (+z = out of face)
columns.right_dir_x: unit z-axis of rightEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.right_dir_y: unit z-axis of rightEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.right_dir_z: unit z-axis of rightEyeTransform, face-anchor coordinates, unitless
columns.stim_bg_gray: scheduled background grey level, sRGB code value 0 (black)..1 (white); not photometric luminance
columns.stim_displacement_pt: scheduled cumulative stripe displacement, SwiftUI points (+ = rightward on screen)
columns.tracked: 1 if ARFaceAnchor.isTracked for this frame, else 0; gaze fields empty when 0

timingNotes: t_s = ARFrame.timestamp - session start, both on the system-uptime clock. Session start is when the first camera frame was received; the stimulus animation uses the same reference. stim_* columns are the stimulus state scheduled for t_s, not a confirmed displayed frame: display latency and camera exposure/processing latency (typically tens of ms) are not compensated.
